title: Passive 1 (is done / was done)
subtitle: Страдательный залог в настоящем и прошедшем: is made, was built

theory.text: В активном залоге говорим, что делает подлежащее: Paul wrote this song. В пассивном — что происходит с подлежащим: This song was written by Paul. (песня была написана).

Пассив берут, когда неважно или неизвестно, кто сделал: My bag was stolen. (кто-то украл), Is the office cleaned every evening? Если исполнителя нужно назвать — через by: This cake was made by my sister.
V3 (past participle) часто оканчивается на -ed (cleaned, invited), но у неправильных глаголов своя форма: built, made, written, stolen, taken.

items: Русские «Его уволили», «Матч отменили», «Бумагу делают из дерева» — это пассив: He was fired. The match was cancelled. Paper is made from wood.
Как что-то называется — тоже пассив: What is this film called?

theory.text: Русские безличные фразы («здесь говорят по-английски», «меня разбудили») не переводят с «they» или без подлежащего. Подлежащим делаем того, с кем что-то произошло: I was woken up. И не забывайте be: The car was repaired, а не «The car repaired».

en: This bridge was built in 1990.
The bridge was built in 1990.
Paper is made from wood.
Paper is made of wood.
This cheese is made in France.
This cheese is produced in France.
The windows are cleaned once a month.
The windows are washed once a month.
Is the office cleaned every evening?

items.ru: На английском говорят во всём мире.
en: English is spoken all over the world.
English is spoken around the world.
English is spoken everywhere in the world.
Is lunch included in the price?
I'm rarely invited to parties.
I'm seldom invited to parties.
I'm not often invited to parties.
Many fires are caused by cigarettes.
A lot of fires are caused by cigarettes.
How is your surname spelt?
How is your surname spelled?
How is your last name spelled?
How is your last name spelt?
What is this film called?
What is this movie called?
What is the film called?
I was woken up by the neighbour's dog.
I was woken by the neighbour's dog.
I was woken up by the neighbor's dog.
I was woken up by my neighbour's dog.
I wasn't invited to the wedding.
My bag was stolen on the train.

items.ru: Этот торт был испечён моей сестрой.
en: This cake was made by my sister.
This cake was baked by my sister.
This song was written by Paul.
When was the telephone invented?
When was the phone invented?
He was fired from his job.
He was sacked from his job.
He was dismissed from his job.
Nobody was injured in the accident.
No one was injured in the accident.
Nobody was hurt in the accident.
No one was hurt in the accident.
The parcel was delivered yesterday.
The package was delivered yesterday.
The car was repaired last week.
The car was fixed last week.
We weren't told about the meeting.
Where were these photos taken?
Where were these pictures taken?
Where were these photographs taken?
The match was cancelled because of the rain.
The match was canceled because of the rain.
The game was cancelled because of the rain.
The match was cancelled because of rain.
